goal: Measure one exact degree-one input-pack specialization against the sealed factored-DAG receipt. Preserve all input writes and timed pointer binding, graph lowering and synchronization, strict output reads, canonical digest, exhaustive assignments, fixture, phase boundaries, lane points, trials, and native workers; bank the result whether it improves, regresses, fails, or is unchanged.

baseline.status: Sealed and preserved; this is the sole immediate before measurement.

candidate.name: exact degree-one constant-fill input packing
candidate.semanticChange: Inside the existing timed refillInputs low/high/mask buffer scopes, use a degree == 1 branch that writes the selected low[0] or high[0] value directly to pointer[lane]. Hoist only the invariant clock-sentinel decision outside the clock plan's lane loop. Retain the prior nested base/coefficient implementation unchanged for degree greater than one.

prefreezeValidation.degreeOneEquivalenceOracle: PASS at B=1,16,256,65536 with arbitrary distinct UInt32 low/high values

preExecutionCheck.rule: Immediately before execution, recompute both source hashes, the compiled-XCTest hash, and mtimes. Execute only if all hashes exactly equal this freeze. Record the observed values in raw.log and the receipt.

timingAndCorrectnessContract.pairedHELUT: Assignment-mask regeneration and writes to every preallocated input buffer, including input pointer binding, through one synchronized graph run, output pointer binding, strict output traversal/decode into complete flat lane-major values, and canonical ordered FNV-1a digest.
timingAndCorrectnessContract.digestOrder: lane-major, then output order [24,25,26,27,28,29,30,31,23], hashing little-endian UInt32 lane, wire, and decoded value

primary: B=65536 input-pack and paired-total medians versus the sealed factored-DAG receipt
B=65536 HELUT paired-total median versus contemporaneous native parallel median
whether any paired crossover occurs through B=65536
secondary: all eight HELUT and native medians
reporting.ratioDirection: baseline median divided by candidate median; greater than 1 means lower candidate time
reporting.medianCaveat: Independent phase medians are not summed. Percentages use the candidate median-total trial.
reporting.noSignificanceClaim: Five unpinned samples support descriptive ratios only, not a statistical generalization.

failurePolicy: Execute the exact preregistered command once and preserve any failure, partial output, unfavorable result, or regression. Do not silently rerun, select a favorable sample set, lower B/trials/workers, move timing boundaries, prebind pointers, skip writes, weaken strict decoding, alter the digest, erase earlier evidence, or replace the sealed baseline.
claimBoundary: One degree-one host-packing specialization in one release-Swift/MPSGraph combinational benchmark on one unpinned Mac16,5. It is not a general Swift, Metal, Apple, HDL, or native-superiority claim.
